# Octopye

Octopye helps UK businesses improve customer journeys and reduce manual work through websites, booking systems, internal tools, automation, integrations, technical support and practical AI implementation.

Core positioning:
- Practical digital systems for businesses that want less manual work and better customer journeys.
- UK-based digital systems and software development.
- AI-assisted but human-led delivery; no unsupported guarantees.
